args.title: Fix password reset email using localhost instead of configured URL
args.body: File: src/notifications/templates.ts. The BASE_URL constant falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, causing password reset (and other) email links to point at localhost in production. The fix should ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly set/read in the production environment, or that templates.ts fails loudly instead of silently falling back to localhost when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a production context.
